purpose: Additive lead control over existing packet DAGs; not a second queue and not evidence of product completion
rules: Existing review holds remain mandatory; worker may prepare review bundles but may not invent reviews.
A ready label never overrides dependencies or execution prerequisites.
Evidence-only or review-pending can explain a historical code baseline, but cannot satisfy a live checkpoint.
Existing GitHub account use is authorized for R33c only after a fresh read-only host probe and exact action approvals; tool connectivity elsewhere is not local gh authentication.
Structural validate_plan.py output is not permission to execute. Apply execution_guard.py and packet/runtime checks.
Empty reviewed_packets and frozen_packets are intentional: this handoff does not preapprove future code or freeze unresolved acceptance thresholds.
Do not replace the artifact registry, duplicate the queues, or rewrite old evidence. Control only adds prerequisites.
A heartbeat tick is not progress; preserve the last real activity timestamp and inspect the actual worker or long-running test process.
